name: Bestiary
description: Creatures, monsters, and daedric entities of Tamriel

entries.content: Giant Rats infest damp dungeons, cellars, and sewer tunnels across Tamriel. They attack in swarms with sharp teeth and diseased claws.
Goblins dwell in caves and forgotten ruins throughout Tamriel. They fight with crude clubs and shields, often ambushing adventurers from dark corridors.
Lizardmen inhabit tropical waterways and humid swamps. They wield crude weapons with surprising strength and thick scaly hides.
Wolves prowl the wild forests and frozen wastes of Skyrim and High Rock. Pack hunters coordinate fast strikes to bring down prey.
Giant Spiders nest in abandoned catacombs and deep caverns. Their venomous fangs inflict deadly poison, slowing their victims.
Skeletons are reanimated undead warriors raised by dark necromancy. They fight without fear or pain, vulnerable to blunt crushing blows.
Zombies are rotting corpses given relentless life through necromantic magic. Their decayed flesh resists standard bladed strikes while carrying virulent diseases.
Ghouls are ravenous undead feeding upon graves in ancient crypts. Their paralyzed touch can freeze a warrior in place instantly.
Orc warriors roam mountain strongholds and ancient citadels. Masters of heavy armor and smithing, they deliver brutal strikes with heavy axes.
Minotaurs are powerful bullheaded humanoids guarding ancient ruins in Cyrodiil and High Rock. Their mighty horns and heavy hammers shatter armor.
Hellhounds are demonic canines summoned from Oblivion. They breathe scorching flames and strike with fiery jaws.
Trolls are three eyed brutes found in wild hills and caves. Their rapid flesh regeneration makes fire magic essential to defeat them.
Wraiths are incorporeal spirits of profound malevolence. Mundane steel passes through their ghostly forms, requiring enchanted weapons or spells.
Fire Atronachs are elemental daedra formed of pure living flame. They fling fireballs and burst in blazing destruction upon defeat.
Frost Atronachs are towering daedra sculpted from crystalline ice. Immune to bitter cold, they crush foes with frozen fists.
Storm Atronachs are daedric titans bound with tempest energy and magnetic stone. They blast lightning arcs across the battlefield.
Winged Twilights are predatory bat winged daedra serving Azura. They dive from ceilings with razor talons and spell reflection.
Medusas are serpent scaled monstrosities inhabiting sunken ruins. Their piercing gaze causes petrification while their bows fire deadly arrows.
Vampires are ancient undead masters of blood and illusion. They drain vital energy, cast high tier destruction magic, and regenerate wounds in darkness.
Liches are immortal sorcerers who achieved undeath through profane rituals. They wield supreme master tier spells and resist nearly all mundane harm.
Clannfears are reptilian daedra with armored heads and vicious claws. They charge with ferocious speed in service to Mehrunes Dagon.
Dreugh are armored aquatic monstrosities haunting coastal reefs and swamps in Morrowind and Black Marsh. Their claws crush heavy armor.
